function: Downlink channel estimation, antenna extrapolation and CSI feedback (reconstruction) in massive MIMO, by one learned denoiser inside half-quadratic-splitting plug-and-play iterations (pp. 5-7).
system: Single-cell FDD massive MIMO-OFDM; BS ULA with 32 antennas, single-antenna UE; 28 GHz, 200 MHz bandwidth, 5 paths; no RIS (pp. 2, 8).
method: Denoising CNN (8 conv layers, 48 kernels) trained offline on noisy/clean CSI pairs, called unsupervised by the authors; plugged into HQS iterations (pp. 5-6).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing scenario O1_28, BS3, user grid 2; 150,000 CSI samples split 100,000 train, 30,000 validation, 20,000 test (pp. 7-8).
test_conditions: One denoiser trained on noisy CSI (0-40 dB); tested on held-out samples of the same scenario with other pilot patterns, antenna selections, compression ratios, SNRs (pp. 8-12).
baselines: Classical: LS, LMMSE, RBF spline interpolation, TVAL3; learned: ChannelNet, ReEsNet, FNN-ADEN, CNN-ADEN, CsiNet+ (pp. 9-10).
metrics: NMSE (dB), cosine similarity (CoS), convergence curves over iterations, number of model parameters (pp. 8-12).
complexity: 175.2K parameters for the single shared model versus 340.9K to 27300.9K for compared DL models (pp. 11-12).
openness: Source code at https://github.com/wc253/PNPMT; DeepMIMO public dataset (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 7: "DeepMIMO channel generation platform [38]" - training and testing use DeepMIMO ray-tracing channels of the O1_28 scenario at 28 GHz (Table I, page 8).
q2_support: p. 9: "a common DL model can be applied for all pilot patterns" - one denoiser trained once on noisy CSI is tested without retraining on other pilot patterns and numbers, antenna selections and compression ratios; no other DeepMIMO scenario or site is tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "Two classical channel estimation methods, i.e., LS and LMMSE [26], and two DL-based channel estimation methods, i.e., ChannelNet [10] and ReEsNet [26]" - compared on NMSE; page 10 adds RBF, FNN-ADEN, CNN-ADEN, TVAL3 and CsiNet+.
q4_support: p. 11: "the DL model in the proposed method requires only 175.2K parameters" - Table III (page 12) lists the parameters of the compared DL models, 340.9K to 27300.9K.
q5_support: p. 8: "The source code of this paper has been publicly uploaded to https://github.com/wc253/PNPMT" - code link in a footnote; DeepMIMO is also a public dataset.
notes: One denoiser, trained once on noisy/clean CSI, is reused for estimation, antenna extrapolation and CSI feedback through HQS plug-and-play iterations; area 2 because all three tasks reconstruct the channel. q2 rests on unseen pilot patterns, antenna selections and compression ratios with no retraining; all data come from one DeepMIMO scenario (O1_28), so cross-scenario generalization is not tested and the reviewer may want to confirm this mark. The authors call the method unsupervised although the denoiser is trained on noisy-clean CSI pairs.
